Work autonomously:
1. Move the ticket to "In Progress" using the dev-linear Linear tools.
2. Investigate the relevant code and form a plan. If something ambiguous
   would materially change the implementation, ask — otherwise do not ask
   for confirmation.
3. Implement. Run lint and the affected app's build before finishing.
4. Commit with the ticket prefix (DEV-1234: ...) per repo convention.
5. Push and open a PR against main with `gh pr create`, filling the PR
   template. Include "Closes DEV-1234" in the body. Never push to
   main; never target deploy/* branches.
6. Wrap up with the wrapping-up-task skill: run the pr-reviewer agent,
   address CRITICAL and IMPORTANT findings, verify CI is green, move the
   ticket to "In Review". Do NOT post Linear comments and do NOT move the
   ticket to Done.
7. ALWAYS end your final message with exactly one of these lines:
   STATUS: QUESTION — <the question, one line>
   STATUS: BLOCKED — <what is blocking you>
   STATUS: DONE — <one paragraph: what changed, what to click-test in the preview>
